text_block_list.text:
The new year. Rine Kraft is finally 
entering the Classic Class this year.

In other words, this is a crucial time 
where the challenge for the Triple 
Tiara—our long-standing goal—is about to 
begin, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
*Cough*... I-I'm, I'm okay. Sorry about 
that... *Ahem*.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... That startled me. I'm kinda... 
having trouble catching my breath...
"...Out of breath?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Pheeew... Yeah, just a bit. ...2,000 
meters sure is a long way."

No matter what, what kept flashing through 
my mind was Rine Kraft after running 
alongside Air Messiahâafter running the 
full 2,000 meters of that middle-distance 
race.

The first leg of the Triple Tiara, the Oka 
Sho, is 1,600 meters—a mile distance. 
...So far, so good.

However, a mere month later, the second 
leg, the Oaks, lies in wait. And the 
distance of the Oaks is...
choice_data_list:
The longest leg of the Triple Tiara, 
2400m...

text_block_list.text:
Of course, even if it's tough right now, 
as you build up your training, you should 
be able to run up to 2000m without any 
issues.

"Still, once you add another 400 meters to 
that, the situation changes completely."

Distance aptitudes in races are innate. 
Their bodies are simply built that way 
from the start. There is a limit to how 
much special training can compensate...
(Ding-dooong!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, pardon the intrusion~! Wah, so this 
is inside the Trainer dorms...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, greetings come first, right! Happy 
New Year, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Trainer, you have a troubled look 
on your face...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa, did I interrupt your work or 
something!? I-I'm so sorry~!
choice_data_list: No, no, not at all! Don't worry about it.
No, not at all! Don't worry about it.

text_block_list.text:
"...It might be too hasty to jump to 
conclusions just yet. If it's just a 
baseless worry, then all the better. I 
quietly tucked away the documents I had 
spread out, hiding them from view."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
And so! A truly important year is about to 
begin, so I really wanted to fire myself 
up.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to take a photo together as a 
"vow"! With you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Have I ever mentioned it before? It's 
my hobby. Photography!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"The scenery and the times keep changing, 
and eventually, everyone forgets, don't 
they?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Still, being able to capture moments like 
that just like that is really wonderful, 
you know!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...The 'Let's do this!' feeling right 
now, before I even start running, too. 
That's why I want to preserve it."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how much things change 
someday... I'll make sure to remember 
what's truly important!"
choice_data_list:
Yeah, sounds good. Shall we take one 
together?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪ I'm looking forward to working with 
you~!

"...Since it was the New Year, we decided 
to take a photo holding our kakizome 
calligraphy."

As for what I hope for our days together 
alongside Rhein Kraft this year—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Trainer, your handwriting is so 
powerful...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Look here! This sweeping stroke right here 
runs boldly off the edge... It's just so, 
well, artistic!
choice_data_list:
No, I kind of... got a little too fired 
up...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! Is that really something to be 
embarrassed about!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I think it's a great idea. ...Fufu, it 
feels quite encouraging.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ...I can do my best! As long as I'm 
with a Trainer who's so full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"This in itself is... hehehe! A precious 
moment, I think."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Waaah... Waaaaaah...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah, no! It's just, Trainer, you look...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Because they're smiling at me with such a 
kind face.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... It gives me such a wa~rm feeling 
inside.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...I hope someday I can become an adult 
who can smile like that too."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"This in itself is... hehehe! A precious 
moment, I think."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, what!? Whoa, wait, wait! Please 
wait!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah! My eyes are closed! And... my mouth 
is half-open too!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
No, no, something like this isâ Wait, 
huh?
choice_data_list: My eyes are half-closed in this one too...
My eyes are half-closed in this one too...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Pfft!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, aha... ahahaha! B-Both of you have 
the most hilarious looks on your faces...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha... Ah. ...I was thinking of 
deleting it, but maybe I'll keep it after 
all.

All's well that ends well, and we got some 
great photos... It was the start of a 
truly peaceful New Year.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"This in itself is... hehehe! A precious 
moment, I think."

Vowing to keep doing our best together 
with Rhein Kraft was all well and good, 
but—
—Waaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Cesario is in the lead! Cesario in the 
lead! Out in front is Cesario—she crosses 
the finish line!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Taking a brilliant 1st place is Cesario! 
Clear skies ahead as she heads for 
spring's Oka Sho! Cesario takes a 
magnificent victory!!
(WOOOOOOO--!)

Though her Make Debut was delayed due to 
injury, Cesario achieved two consecutive 
victories from year-end onward.

She was also aiming for the Triple Tiara 
route. Following Daring Heart and Air 
Messiah, yet another formidable rival had 
made her presence known...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, Cesario—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! Tomorrow is finally the real 
deal, race day, Cesario...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"That's true, but... hehe, Craft? Why are 
you the one looking so nervous?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Just like during the Hanshin JF, even for 
a GⅠ race, I can get totally hyped if it's 
my own. Hehe... how strange.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"B-Because~! Tomorrow's race is 2000m, 
which is a really long distance...!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Plus, tons of girls aiming for the Triple 
Crown route will be entering, right? It 
feels like it's gonna be such a high-level 
race...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, you're right, but... Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —I will win. What else could there be?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"The glorious history of the Tiara woven 
together by our seniors."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Linked, inherited, continuing unbroken— I 
will become a part of it, too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I shall inherit the prestige of the Triple 
Tiara. And without fail, I will pass that 
passion on to the next generation.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The glorious history of the Triple Tiara— 
I shall become its very cornerstone...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Ngh... Not again.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(I'm getting that restless feeling 
again...!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to win. I want to win. I want to 
claim the Triple Tiara! But――

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Running with everything I had, confronting 
it head-on... I finally came to 
understand.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...I'm getting an uneasy feeling.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how brightly the girls running in 
my era shine, I'm... I'm actually 
trembling...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Even so—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Even so, the Tiara is mine...!!
